invariants.rule: Every ACTIVE pair has exactly one active L component and one active R component except during an explicitly recorded replacement or missing-component condition.
A component may belong to at most one active pair at a time.
Ownership never changes from location, custody, rental, reservation, or maintenance events.
Ownership changes only through transfer_ownership with OWNER_ADMIN authorization and an OWNERSHIP_TRANSFERRED event.
At most one active rental exists for a pair.
A normal checkout requires AVAILABLE state, a complete pair, no blocking maintenance, and no reservation lockout conflict.
A check-in must resolve an active rental unless an authorized correction workflow is used.
Events are append-only. Corrections use compensating events; durable events are never silently edited or deleted.
A financial record never creates, deletes, or substitutes for a physical rental-use event.
A payment record does not imply a particular skate was used unless a rental event exists.
A pair in QUARANTINED, MISSING_COMPONENT, LOST, RETIRED, or blocking maintenance state cannot be normally checked out.
The same command idempotency key must produce the same logical outcome or a deterministic conflict.
recorded_at is assigned by the authoritative runtime; occurred_at may precede recorded_at for offline events but must not be used to rewrite prior durable history.
Current state projections must be rebuildable from the event ledger plus immutable reference/master data.
Counter operation must not require customer PII for ordinary rentals.
